rooms.name: Scorched Entry Hall
rooms.description: A long hall with a vaulted ceiling, cracked and stained by fire. Iron torch-brackets line the walls, still glowing with enchanted flames that have burned for decades without fuel. The floor is patterned tile, warped and buckled by heat. Corridors branch east and west.

interactables.label: cracked floor vent
interactables.description: A vent in the floor periodically belches a jet of arcane fire upward.

actionData.detectMessage: You spot the cracked floor vent ahead and step carefully around it.
actionData.dodgeMessage: A jet of arcane fire erupts from the floor — you throw yourself aside!
actionData.damageMessage: A jet of arcane fire erupts from the floor vent, engulfing you! (-{damage} HP)

rooms.name: West Corridor
rooms.description: A narrow corridor with collapsed classrooms on either side. Desks and chairs are visible through doorways, all charred. An arcane ward shimmers across the corridor ahead — a pale blue barrier that crackles faintly. Three rune-pillars are visible in the rubble, their activation sequence long forgotten.

interactables.label: rune-pillar marked α
interactables.description: A stone pillar inscribed with the rune Alpha. Part of a three-rune ward-breaking sequence.

actionData.advanceMessage: You press the Alpha rune. It flares blue and hums — the ward ahead flickers.
actionData.resetMessage: The rune flares red and goes dark. The ward strengthens. Start from Alpha.
actionData.alreadySolvedMessage: The Alpha rune glows steady blue. The sequence is complete.

interactables.label: cracked ceiling section
interactables.description: The ceiling here is dangerously fractured, ready to collapse on the unwary.

actionData.detectMessage: You notice the ceiling is dangerously fractured and edge along the wall to avoid it.
actionData.dodgeMessage: Stones crash down from the ceiling — you lunge clear!
actionData.damageMessage: The ceiling gives way above you! Heavy stones slam into you! (-{damage} HP)

rooms.name: East Corridor
rooms.description: The east wing of the academy, where the advanced laboratories were. The walls here are slick with condensed magical residue — a faintly luminous orange film. Something large and hot patrols this corridor. The second rune-pillar stands against the far wall.

interactables.label: rune-pillar marked β
interactables.description: A stone pillar inscribed with the rune Beta. Second in the ward-breaking sequence.

actionData.advanceMessage: You press the Beta rune. It flares blue — the ward ahead weakens further.
actionData.resetMessage: The rune flares red. Wrong order. The ward reforms. Start from Alpha.
actionData.alreadySolvedMessage: The Beta rune glows steady blue. The sequence is complete.

rooms.name: Shattered Laboratory
rooms.description: A large chamber that was once the academy's main experimental lab. Shattered glass apparatus, warped metal frames, and pools of solidified alchemical residue cover the floor. A bound infernal paces behind a containment circle that has held for decades — barely. The third rune-pillar stands by the south door.

interactables.label: rune-pillar marked γ
interactables.description: A stone pillar inscribed with the rune Gamma. Final rune in the ward-breaking sequence. Activating it in the correct order will drop the ward in the west corridor.

actionData.successMessage: You press the Gamma rune. All three pillars pulse blue in unison — the arcane ward in the west corridor shatters with a crystalline crack. The way south from the west corridor is open.
actionData.resetMessage: The rune flares red. Wrong order. The ward reforms. Start from Alpha.
actionData.alreadySolvedMessage: The Gamma rune glows steady blue. The ward is already down.

rooms.name: Sentinel Chamber
rooms.description: A round chamber where the Ash Sentinel stands guard — a towering construct of fused stone and ember, built by Vatric to protect the inner sanctum. The construct's eye-slits glow a steady orange. Behind it, a heavy iron door leads south to the sanctum antechamber.

rooms.name: Sanctum Antechamber
rooms.description: A narrow antechamber before Vatric's sanctum door. The door is massive — black iron bound in bronze, covered in arcane inscriptions. A brass speaking-face is set at eye height, its lips parted. The inscription above reads: "Speak the answer, or burn." The riddle must be spoken aloud to open the way.

interactables.label: inscribed sanctum door
interactables.description: A massive black iron door covered in arcane inscriptions. A brass speaking-face waits at eye height, its lips parted.

actionData.question: I am sought by all who study, feared by all who wield, and lost by all who master. What am I?
actionData.hint: Vatric's journal speaks of what drove him: not power itself, but the thing that precedes it.
actionData.successMessage: The brass face nods slowly, its eyes lighting with approval. "Correct." The massive door groans inward, trailing dust and the stench of old fire. Vatric's sanctum lies beyond.
actionData.failureMessage: The brass face's eyes flare red. "Wrong." Heat blasts from its mouth — the inscriptions glow white-hot for a moment, then dim. The door remains sealed.

interactables.label: pressure-triggered fire rune
interactables.description: A fire rune is etched into the floor before the sanctum door.

actionData.detectMessage: You recognize the fire rune on the floor and step carefully over it.
actionData.resistMessage: The fire rune erupts — you shield your mind and endure the worst of the blast.
actionData.damageMessage: A fire rune on the floor detonates beneath your feet! Arcane flame engulfs you! (-{damage} HP)

rooms.name: Vatric's Sanctum
rooms.description: The heart of the Pyromancer's Folly — a vast circular chamber beneath a cracked dome. Fire still burns in the central pit where Vatric's experiment went wrong, casting dancing orange light on walls lined with scorched bookshelves. The Cinder-Lich Vatric stands at the far side of the fire, what remains of him — a skeletal figure wreathed in perpetual flame, still clutching a staff of fused glass and bone.

rooms.name: Hidden Forge Altar
rooms.description: A concealed vault behind the sanctum's west wall, accessible only after defeating the ward. A massive stone forge-altar dominates the room — its surface carved with fire runes and bearing a central depression the size of a fist. Heat radiates from the altar even now.

interactables.label: stone forge-altar with fire runes
interactables.description: A massive stone forge-altar with a fist-sized depression at its centre. Something ember-hot would fit here.

actionData.promptText: The forge-altar's central depression radiates heat. Which item from your pack do you place here?
actionData.successMessage: You press the Sentinel's Ember Core into the depression. It locks into place with a deep resonant hum — the altar blazes to life, fire runes tracing bright lines across the stone, and the east wall grinds open to reveal Vatric's hidden vault.
actionData.failureMessage: The altar does not respond. Whatever you placed, it is not what the forge requires.
